title: Body Destroyed
summary: When the Cassia Valley deadline expires, only one of seven tokens remains and word spreads that one person took them all. Wang Lin appears before the gathered Nascent Soul ancestors and challenges Teng Huayuan, using the illusion bead to pass himself off as a mid Nascent Soul expert. He fights with illusions, Blue Ice Flash and a replica flying sword, then breaks open the Soul Flag to reach his parents' souls, but Teng Huayuan seals him in and lets the souls gnaw at him. Wang Lin destroys the last token so that no Zhao sect can enter the foreign battlefield for another five hundred years. As his body is destroyed he looks back on Heng Yue, Zhang Hu and the Wang family, asking whether weakness is the original sin. Situ Nan wakes, uses the last of his soul power to send Wang Lin's last thread of consciousness into the foreign battlefield, and falls asleep again. There, a troll-race expert at Soul Transformation and other cultivators scavenge among dangerous space rifts.
